messages.en:
Hi! How's it going? I'm
looking forward to seeing
you! Bye!

December 24th
Started work: 07:45 a.m.
Got home: 12:00 a.m.
Overtime: 7 h. 30 min.

Hello! If we ever get a
chance to meet up, let's
take it. Until then, I'm
going fishing!

I hope someone cool reads
this letter...and I hope
I get a response!

TV with VCR: 1,600 Bells
Invisible shirt: 460 Bells
Floorless rug: 1,750 Bells
TOTAL: 3,810 Bells

If you're reading this,
it's probably too late for
me! Take care of things
for me, would you?

There are two paths to
enlightenment: kindness
and oneness with your
universe.

You're the winner of a
trip around the world!
Please make your deposit
as soon as possible!

This special offer is just
for you! Sign up now,
before it's too late! Don't
be fooled by imitations!

This summer I planted
lots of peaches and went
fishing a lot. I caught
two fish. It was fun.

What kind of backwater
town doesn't have apples?!
Mine! It would be great if
someone shared theirs...

I'm not the best at
expressing myself, but I
appreciate you more than
words can say. Thanks.

A peach tree blooms pink.
A warm breeze rustles
the leaves.
Spring unfolds its arms.

So, I heard you got
hitched! Another one bites
the dust! Stop by when
you visit your folks next!

A film with a production
cost of $20,000,000,000
and an all-star cast
coming soon!

It seems that there is
nothing for me in this
town. Next, I shall visit
yours.

1) Avoid excessive heat.
2) Avoid extreme cold.
3) Avoid boredom by
   playing an hour a day.

F I S H
     D I S H
     D I S K

Remember that ya gotta 
save when you're done
playin' your game, ya
hear me?

Because Mars is entering
Capricorn, you should wear
big shoes and do the
chicken dance. Repeatedly.

The new moon in Pisces
will compel you to run
around and shake every
tree you come across.

During the lunar eclipse,
you'll run around like a
shovel-wielding maniac.
Wear a hockey mask.

Even if you send this 
letter to five people, 
nothing good will happen
to you.

Tom Nook's shop is
finally a convenience
store! How's yours?
How's the selection?

I'm gonna make a killing
on turnips! Or so I 
thought, until I ate
them. Heh heh heh...{00 08 00}

10 percent off every
type of burger!
Limit 1 coupon per
customer. Expires 8/31.

Salary     28,200 Bells
Overtime   32,600 Bells
Income tax 15,700 Bells
Total      45,100 Bells

Seeking new and seasoned
adventurers to pick fruit,
fish, and much more! Earn
up to 800 Bells per hour!

We finally did it!{00 01 00}
We look forward to our
future together and all 
that it holds!

I can't throw a curve-
ball. If I wanna throw a
curveball like a pro,
what do I need to do?

All you need to do is
test some fine cosmetics.
Over 3,000 Bells per hour.
NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY!!

Calories:   7 
Sugar:     0 mg
Vitamin C:  100 mg
Fiber:      50 mg

I've sent you so many
letters. When am I gonna
get one back?! I can't
sleep thinking about it...

I'm waiting, you know! You
said you would write daily.
Is there someone else?
Another pen pal?

How are things over
there? If you catch a
cold, you should wedge an 
onion slice in your nose!

Dial 911 if you see him!
Name: Invisible Guy
Offense: Running a red
Description: Invisible

I'm going home later this
month and you should
come, too. Mom worries!

Height: 5' 6"
Weight: 193 lbs
Body fat: 47 percent
No concerns
